name: Must be Feng Shui
description:
About This Game

Every home is a puzzle

In Must be Feng Shui, you bring harmony to apartments and houses by arranging furniture according to the principles of Feng Shui.
Each piece follows its own rules — a bed shouldn’t face a mirror, a desk shouldn’t block a doorway, and a wardrobe shouldn’t block the natural light from windows.
How you position and combine these elements determines the balance of the entire space.

Arrange, experiment, and find balance

There’s no single right answer. Rotate, move, and experiment with furniture to find layouts that satisfy every rule in your own way.
Relax, take your time, and enjoy the process of turning each room into a calm, balanced space.

Unlock new homes

As you progress, you’ll unlock new chapters with larger apartments and more intricate layouts.
Each space offers a fresh opportunity to apply feng shui in creative ways — no pressure, just peaceful problem-solving.

Test your own space

Ever wondered if your own room follows feng shui rules?
In sandbox mode, you can recreate your real apartment, place furniture as you have it (or as you’d like it to be), and see how harmonious your personal space truly is.

Features

  • Arrange furniture according to authentic feng shui rules

  • Each piece has specific placement principles that affect others

  • Unlock new chapters with larger and more diverse spaces

  • Relaxing, no-timer puzzles with multiple valid solutions

  • Minimalist visuals and soothing atmosphere

  • Sandbox mode to test your own home’s harmony
short_desc: Must be Feng Shui is a relaxing puzzle game where you arrange furniture to follow Feng Shui rules. Recreate your own home in sandbox mode, or decorate existing cozy apartments to restore their balance.
